name: Inkloom Sigillum — Live Vertical Slice Verification
changes: Added a live HTTP vertical-slice smoke script for the creator-to-reviewer lifecycle.
Recorded participant-confirmed Windows frontend lint, TypeScript and production build results.
Updated phase-gate, demo-runbook, README and AI/reuse-disclosure records.
Added a reproducible live smoke result report.
limitations: Live smoke covers the HTTP API lifecycle, not browser automation.
The local demo runtime is synchronous and uses SQLite plus local filesystem storage.
PostgreSQL/pgvector and MinIO are not active application adapters.
Durable worker orchestration, production multi-tenant isolation and automated visual identity/contrast certification are not implemented.
